newsitem.title: ITALY: Marzotto H1 1996 cons net profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Marzotto H1 1996 cons net profit falls.

text.p: Note - Clothing company Marzotto Spa said the fall in turnover was due to weak demand in textiles and apparel, particularly in the linen sector, with the Italian market contracting 11.1 percent and markets abroad down 2.9 percent.
Marzotto said it expected demand to remain weak in coming months and it expected overall turnover for 1996 to be five percent down on 1995, due to foreign exchange effects.
It said profit margins should remain stable in percentage terms in line with 1995 and the year should show a significant generation of liquidity helping to reduce net financial debt.
